all.description: Producers of the grandest pageant in town.

roleInfo.name: Producer
roleInfo.description: Stage a dazzling pageant — but dodge the low scores. 🎭

Default.tutorialQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.welcomeText: Send contestants onto the stage — but sweep up as few as you can. The lowest score wins!
Default.tutText1: You're producing a beauty pageant of numbered contestants in 6 sash colors. Sweep up as FEW as possible — the lowest score wins!
Default.tutText2: On your turn, play one contestant to the END of the stage lineup, then draw back up to 5 cards.
Default.tutText3: Your card's number N shields the last N contestants. Anyone earlier in the line who shares your color OR has a number ≤ N joins your troupe — and that's bad!
Default.tutText4: Collected contestants pile into your troupe deck, which everyone can inspect. You can also see a summary of which colors you've collected in your video box.
Default.tutText5: Add up the numbers in your troupe — the LOWEST total wins. But for each color, whoever holds the most flips those cards to just 1 point each.
Default.tutText6: The show ends when someone collects all 6 colors, or the draw pile empties. Everyone takes one last turn, discards 2 cards, then scores. Good luck!
Default.playPrompt: ($1), send a contestant onto the stage!
Default.endgameText: Everyone gets one last turn on stage — then each producer discards 2 contestants.
Default.drawHalfText: The draw pile is running low — the show won't last forever.
Default.drawLowText: When the draw pile empties, the final round begins.
Default.drawOutHeader: The draw pile has run out!
Default.finalBow: Final bow! Discard 2 contestants — the rest join your troupe.
Default.leadersHeader: Color leaders — the most of each flips to 1 pt each!
